Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs a multi-tiered approach. The primary proteome analysis used DIA-LFQ (Bottom-up). A separate tier involved the purification of IgG1/ACPA and subsequent intact Fab profiling (Top-down/Intact), but the PRIDE metadata and main proteomics methods focus on the DIA bottom-up workflow. The affinity purification of antibodies triggers the mod_ap_ms hint.
